## RCA (Phase 1 — proven, runtime-confirmed)

**Root cause (changeable artifact):** `src/rebar/_commands/doctor.py:497` calls
`doctor_mcp_client.scan_mcp_clients()` with no `home=` argument, so it defaults to
`Path.home()` and reads the operator's real HOME MCP client configs. The doctor tests
that drive the real `doctor_cli` entry point (`test_doctor_dirty_tree` ×2 and the
`doctor_cli` cases in `test_doctor_mapping`) do not isolate `HOME`, so every such test
transitively reads `~/.codex/config.toml`, `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`, `~/.claude.json`.

**Runtime proof (this box):** driving `doctor.doctor_cli(['--output','json'])` yields
`mcp_client_findings` whose `path`s are literally
`/Users/joeoakhart/.codex/config.toml`, `/Users/joeoakhart/.copilot/mcp-config.json`,
`/Users/joeoakhart/.claude.json` (kinds: pat-unresolvable ×3). The scanner is fully
injectable (`home=`), and `test_doctor_mcp_client.py` exercises it hermetically — but the
CLI call site passes no `home`, so the integration path reads live machine state.

**AC#2 (malformed/partial config can't raise or change exit) is ALREADY satisfied by
design, not a code bug:** `scan_mcp_clients` turns every OSError/decode/TOML/JSON error
into a finding (never raises), and `doctor.py` deliberately keeps `mcp_client_findings`
OUT of the exit code (`return 1 if outstanding or lock_faults or blocking_mapping else 0`;
see the 'deliberately ADVISORY' comment). `test_malformed_config_degrades_to_a_finding_not_an_exception`
already pins the no-raise contract. So the remaining defect is purely test hermeticity
(AC#1/#3).

**Legitimacy:** `defect` (test-integrity). Violates the unit tier's own stated invariant —
`tests/unit/conftest.py::_no_real_session_log_writes` ('Unit tests must never perform a
REAL … write … never touch the real store') — and the scanner docstring's intent that
'home and env are injectable so the whole surface is testable'.

**Attribution:** caused_by 71e7-4626-cb19-42d7 (affable-bleakish-yellowlegs), introducing
commit f1dd41a8f099 'Diagnose MCP client PAT wiring in doctor' — the change that added the
real-HOME scan and wired it into `doctor_cli` without isolating the pre-existing
`doctor_cli` tests. Class: plan_defect (the plan added a real-HOME read on a tested path
without adding the corresponding test isolation).

**Fix (Phase 2):** test-only, behavior-preserving. Add a whole-unit-tier autouse HOME
isolation fixture in `tests/unit/conftest.py` (mirroring the existing session-log seam
neutralization) so no unit test reads the operator's real home; production `doctor`
behavior (reading real HOME in production) is unchanged.
